theme: 3 terms on text in Swift: one single letter, mixing values into a message, and cutting a slice out of a string

terms.definition: A type that holds exactly one letter, digit or symbol.
terms.example: `key` is a Character, so it holds just one letter.

terms.definition: A feature that puts values inside a string by wrapping them in a backslash and parentheses.
terms.example: I used String Interpolation to show the score in the message.
terms.code:
let name = "Mina"
let score = 3
print("\(name) has \(score) points")

terms.definition: A type that holds a slice of a String and shares its text.
terms.example: `prefix(5)` gives me a Substring, not a new String.
terms.code:
let title = "Swift Basics"
let first = title.prefix(5)
print(first)
print(type(of: first))

quizzes.question: In this code, what do you call putting `name` and `score` inside the text with a backslash?
quizzes.code:
let name = "Mina"
let score = 3
let line = "\(name) has \(score) points"

quizzes.question: What do you call a slice of a String that shares the original text?

video.description:
Learn to explain text handling in Swift: Character, String Interpolation & Substring, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Character - A type that holds exactly one letter, digit or symbol.
String Interpolation - A feature that puts values inside a string by wrapping them in a backslash and parentheses.
Substring - A type that holds a slice of a String and shares its text.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: Swift Character, String Interpolation & Substring | Day 35
landscape.description:
Explain Character, String Interpolation & Substring in Swift by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
캐릭터, 스트링 인터폴레이션, 서브스트링 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Character - A type that holds exactly one letter, digit or symbol.
한국어: 캐릭터: 글자, 숫자, 기호 하나만 담는 타입

String Interpolation - A feature that puts values inside a string by wrapping them in a backslash and parentheses.
한국어: 스트링 인터폴레이션: 백슬래시와 괄호로 문자열 안에 값을 넣는 기능

Substring - A type that holds a slice of a String and shares its text.
한국어: 서브스트링: String의 일부를 잘라 원본 텍스트를 공유하는 타입

In this video, Mina and Jake sort out why a value is not a String, how to put values in a message and what a single letter is, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Can you explain these string terms in English?

dialogue.title: Why is first not a String?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my compiler says `first` is not a String. Why?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: `prefix(5)` returns a Substring, not a String.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A slice of `title`. It shares the same text, so it is cheap.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I still put it in `line` with String Interpolation?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. String Interpolation works with any value. Just write `\(first)`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I forgot the type, so `key` was a String, not a Character.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Add `: Character` and it holds exactly one letter.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Should I keep the Substring for a long time?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No. Convert it to a String, because a Substring keeps the whole original text alive.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Got it. Character for one letter, String Interpolation for messages, Substring for slices.

dialogue.code:
let title = "Swift Basics"
let first = title.prefix(5)
let key: Character = "S"
let line = "Top: \(first)"
